claim_ceiling: A regression-signal measurement of two trees in THIS environment at THIS root. It says nothing about the correctness of the inherited failures (they are reproduced, not adjudicated), nothing about any frozen bar or serve verdict, nothing about any other environment, and nothing about the product's usefulness: the suite is a regression signal, not a quality measure.

method.base_tree: a detached git worktree at the accepted base commit, created and removed by this tool
method.collection: the collected totals are measured with the lane's own product/test_delta_attribution.py::collect_count (collection only), not read off the pytest summary
method.failed_set: parsed from pytest's own 'FAILED <test id>' short summary lines, one entry per test id
method.set_relation: head-only / base-only / shared are computed as set relations over test ids

set_relation: head_only = FAILED(head) \ FAILED(base); base_only = FAILED(base) \ FAILED(head); shared = FAILED(head) ∩ FAILED(base). The sets are computed as SET RELATIONS over test ids, never by matching counts.
